result.title: P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models
result.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Interactive version: https://research.tearlabs.ai/pyes-search/ . Code and data: https://github.com/tear-labs/pyes-search
result.summary: Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

AI.brief_summary: 在被冻结的决策模型上加入免训练测试时搜索：让模型对完整候选答案给出「正确」的 Yes 概率，再通过单答案编辑或联合优化寻找更高分答案，在逻辑谜题等任务上大幅提升严格正确率。
AI.relevance_reason: 提供以模型自评分作验证器、引导候选答案搜索的免训练测试时扩展线索，可能迁移到 LVR 中候选 latent 假设的筛选、搜索与停止判断；但研究对象为纯文本决策任务，与视觉推理状态的联系需核查。
